subject: Final paperflow & wiring — confirm signers, signature timing, and start date

Subject: MAP + final paperwork — signing window and target start date

Hi Laura / Vectra procurement team,

Thanks again for the productive evaluation cycle — attached is the finalized mutual action plan (MAP_Redwood_Vectra_20270815.pdf) and the draft SOW (v3). Per our last call the remaining items are:

- Legal redline acceptance (Tom)
- Finance wiring and billing milestone (procurement)
- Signature matrix and who signs on Day 0

Proposed cadence:
1) Legal confirms redline by Tue 8/17 COB
2) DocuSign envelope issued Wed 8/18 AM to the four signers in the matrix
3) Signature window closes Fri 8/20 EOD; finance initiates wiring same day
4) Start date (first provisioning) Mon 8/23

Can you confirm the signer list and whether procurement needs any specific PO wording or vendor registration details? I also copied Kimberly (Revenue Ops) and Rafael (Solutions) to lock the SOW/milestones.

If this timeline works we will: finalize SOW in-place, push DocuSign, and circulate the final signature_matrix_v2.csv for visibility.

Thanks — I can jump on a quick 15 if you want to walk through the flow.

— Soojin

Thanks Tom — appreciate the quick review.

We will: incorporate the two clarifications into SOW v3 and push v4 by 08/16 17:00 PDT. Rafael, Connor — Rafael will confirm the indemnity wording and Connor from Finance will provide vendor wiring instructions and the standard PO language.

Tom/Laura, two quick asks for procurement:
- Does Vectra require the vendor to be fully onboarded in your vendor portal prior to issuing a PO?
- Do you have a preferred invoice cadence (30/45/60) or milestone-based invoicing?

If procurement can confirm those two items today we can keep the DocuSign plan for 8/18.

Regards,

Hi all,

Procurement here — quick answers:
- Vendor portal: yes, vendor should be created in our portal before PO issuance; we can do a fast-track entry using Redwood's W-9 and company information (please send so we can create the vendor record by 8/17).
- Invoice cadence: milestone-based preferred. We will accept 30-day net from milestone acceptance.
- Wiring: we will need Redwood's banking form (ACH details) plus the completed vendor portal entry.

We'll expect DocuSign envelope after legal clears SOW. If Redwood can provide the vendor form and the signature matrix today it will keep us on track for 8/18.

Thanks,
Vectra Procurement
procurement@vectrahealth.com
